newsitem.title: UK: BOC fire caused by cylinder - Firebrigade.
newsitem.headline: BOC fire caused by cylinder - Firebrigade.

text.p: A fire and explosion at a BOC Group Plc plant in south London was caused by an exploding cylinder, the London firebrigade said on Friday.
"For some reason we don't yet know a cylinder has exploded, killing one man and injuring another who has been taken to hospital with minor injuries," a firebrigade spokesman said.
He said the explosion and fire had destroyed between 15 and 20 percent of the cylinder-filling plant at the site in Morden.
The site had been evacuated and no other injuries had been reported, the London Firebrigade said.
BOC said the site at Morden was used for technology development as well as filling cylinders with specialty gases for industrial use.
A BOC spokesman said 148 people were employed at the site, with 84 working in the cylinder-filling operation.
Shares in BOC were down 16 1/2 pence at 925 in early afternoon trading.
